haiku.problem: The Bible quote stops mid-sentence at "exile" without a "…" even though the verse continues with "therefore." The rule requires "…" where a quote cuts off.
The quote "therefore I will indeed expose the flank of Moab" stops mid-sentence without a "…", though the verse continues with "beginning with its frontier cities."
The quote stops at "guilt" mid-sentence without a "…", though the sentence continues with "therefore" in verse 13.
The quote stops at "Israel" mid-sentence without a "…", though the verse continues with ", and they will deal with Edom."
